title.id: Emas Turun Tipis di Sesi Sydney; Sorotan pada Tambang & Pasokan
title.en: Gold Edges Lower in Sydney Session; Mining & Supply in Focus

lede.id: Harga emas spot turun 0,13% selama sesi Sydney, dari US$3.573,70 menjadi US$3.569,00 per troy ons antara pukul 05.00 dan 14.00 WIB.
lede.en: Spot gold fell 0.13% during the Sydney session, slipping from $3,573.70 to $3,569.00 an ounce between 05:00 and 14:00 WIB.
